fullDescription: A premium dark-themed landing page design system named Lumina, characterized by luxury gold accents (#c5a059), sophisticated editorial typography, and interactive 3D background elements. This style utilizes a deep charcoal palette (#080808), glassmorphism, and generous white space to create an 'atelier' or 'high-gallery' feel. Key features include oversized headings with a mix of sans-serif display and serif italic fonts, interactive 3D neon-tube cursor effects, and high-contrast call-to-action buttons. It is perfectly suited for luxury fashion, high-end architecture firms, fine art portfolios, boutique digital agencies, and premium lifestyle brands. The layout is minimalist, emphasizing sensory interaction and subtle animations.

structured.summary: Lumina is a luxury-tier interactive hero and landing page design system. It focuses on 'sensory digital architecture' using deep blacks, metallic golds, and a blend of Space Grotesk and Crimson Pro typography. The design emphasizes motion through 3D background interactivity and smooth reveal animations.

style.description: The style is 'Premium Minimalism' with a focus on high-end textures and color restraint. Primary colors are Deep Charcoal (#080808) and Metallic Gold (#c5a059). Typography pairings include 'Space Grotesk' for modern, wide display headings and 'Crimson Pro' for elegant, light-weighted italic serifs used in body text and sub-headings. Animations are characterized by long-duration (1.2s) cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) ease-out 'RevealUp' transitions. Interactive elements use high-blur glassmorphism (20px blur) and subtle metallic gradients.
style.prompt: ### Color Palette - Background: #080808 (Deep Charcoal) - Accents: #c5a059 (Gold), #b8860b (Dark Gold), #e8d0a3 (Soft Gold) - Text: Primary #FFFFFF, Secondary #FFFFFF with 40% opacity, Accents #c5a059 ### Typography - Display Headings: Space Grotesk (Weights: 300, 400). Use for large titles (6rem to 8rem) with tracking-tighter. - Serif Body/Accent: Crimson Pro (Weights: 200, 400, Italic). Use for sophisticated subtext and emphasized phrases. - Utility/UI Text: Public Sans (Weights: 400, 600). Use for navigation and labels with tracking-ultra (0.3em) and font-size 10px-12px. ### Effects & Animations - Reveals: All main elements must use a 'revealUp' animation (opacity 0 -> 1, translate-y 20px -> 0) over 1.2s with cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1). - Glassmorphism: Background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) with 20px backdrop-blur and 1px border at rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). - Buttons: Linear gradient gold (#c5a059 to #b8860b), no border-radius, 0.5s hover transition with box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.3).

layout_and_structure.description: The layout is a single-screen focused hero section with a three-part structure: a high-spaced header, a centered hero core, and a technical-style footer. It relies on a full-viewport interactive canvas layer positioned behind the content.

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Design a wide-padding (px-12) header at 100% width. Left side: A brand logo consisting of a 32px square border rotated 45 degrees with an icon inside. Center: Desktop navigation using ultra-small (10px) uppercase text with 0.25em letter spacing. Right side: A 'CONTACT' link with a persistent bottom border (border-b) that transitions color on hover. The header should animate in with a 1.2s reveal effect.

Centered main content area with a max-width of 6xl. Layout: 1. Top label in gold (#c5a059) with tracking-ultra (0.3em). 2. Oversized H1 (8rem) using Space Grotesk, incorporating a line break to a second line featuring Crimson Pro Italic. 3. Descriptive paragraph (text-xl) in light italic serif, max-width 2xl, centered. 4. CTA Row: One solid gold rectangular button and one ghost-style video button with a circular play icon (border white/10).

Position footer at the bottom of the viewport with px-12 padding. Left side: A 'status' indicator with a small horizontal line, technical label ('SENSORY ENGINE ACTIVE'), and a secondary instruction text block (10px size, text-white/30). Right side: A grouping of archival links and an 'up-right' arrow icon, separated by 48px horizontal lines. Layout should be flex-row for desktop and stack for mobile.

special_ui_components.description: A full-screen Three.js or similar canvas background that responds to mouse movement.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a canvas element covering 100% of the viewport. The background should feature thick 3D tubes/lines that weave across the screen. Colors should fluctuate between #1a1a1a, #c5a059, and #333333. On user click, the light intensity should spike and colors should rotate between gold and silver palettes. Ensure a brightness filter of 0.6 is applied to prevent text legibility issues.

special_ui_components.description: A rectangular, non-rounded button with a rich metallic gradient.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a button with zero border-radius. Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c5a059 0%, #b8860b 100%). Text should be black (#000000), font size 11px, weight 700, and 0.2em tracking. Hover state: translateY(-2px) and a large, soft outer glow (drop-shadow) using #c5a059 at 30% opacity.

structured.special_notes: MUST-DO: Ensure all typography uses the specified tracking values (ultra-wide for labels, tight for headings). MUST-DO: Use the cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) timing for all transitions to maintain the 'premium' feel. MUST-NOT: Use rounded corners on primary CTA buttons; keep them sharp/rectangular. MUST-NOT: Use standard bright colors; stick strictly to the charcoal and gold palette.
